description: This file defines a RecyclerView.Adapter named ContentRowAdapter for rendering content rows in an Android application. Each row displays a title and a horizontal list of content cards, with focus management logic to ensure titles are visible when navigating via DPAD.

classes.name: ContentRowAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter that manages a list of content rows, each containing a title and a horizontal list of content cards.

classes.name: ContentRow
classes.description: Data model representing a row of content with a title and items.

classes.name: RowVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for ContentRowAdapter, managing views for a content row.

methods.name: submitList
methods.description: Submits a new list of ContentRow items to the adapter.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item view layout and creates a new ViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a ContentRow item to the ViewHolder.

methods.name: areItemsTheSame
methods.description: Checks if two ContentRow items are the same based on their title.

methods.name: areContentsTheSame
methods.description: Checks if the contents of two ContentRow items are the same.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds data from a ContentRow to the ViewHolder's views, setting up the inner RecyclerView for content cards and focus behavior.
